title: Balance the bridge
story: A sensor (RX) sits in the lower-left arm of a Wheatstone bridge and right now reads 3.3 kOhm. The top arms are 10 kOhm (left) and 1 kOhm (right). Choose the resistor for the lower-right arm so the bridge is balanced: the voltage between the two midpoints must be within 10 mV of zero.

goals.label: bridge output between -10 mV and +10 mV

hints: Each side of the bridge is a voltage divider. The bridge is balanced when both midpoints sit at the same voltage.
Balance means R1 x R4 = RX x R3. Here the top arms have a 10 to 1 ratio, so the bottom arms need the same 10 to 1 ratio.
